name: Live Dispatch Map
note: A street-grid city map in inline SVG where every route is built from straight legs along the streets, so vans glide along real roads in a requestAnimationFrame loop that pauses off screen, when the tab is hidden or when Live is toggled off; each job pin carries an SLA ring drawn with pathLength, and assigning the nearest skilled crew (ranked by computed ETA) draws its route and starts the van moving. Set --dcf-dispatch-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Critical Path Schedule
note: A real forward and backward CPM pass over eighteen linked activities on a working-day calendar with a Christmas shutdown; stepping any duration re-runs it, bars move by transitioning clip-path insets on a spring, and the finish-to-start connectors morph with a CSS d: path() transition while total float, the contract buffer and liquidated-damages exposure update. Rows are subgrids of one grid so the sticky table and timeline share tracks; set --dcf-critical-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Plant Utilisation Barcode
note: Every machine's telematics is drawn as an hour-by-hour barcode on its own DPR-aware canvas (working, idling, breakdown, outside shift), so rows can be re-sorted with a FLIP animation from the Web Animations API and re-wiped with clip-path when the period changes; utilisation, idle fuel, hire spend and off-hire candidates are all computed from the same hourly states. Set --dcf-fleet-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Safety Cross & Incident Log
note: A site safety cross laid out by CSS grid placement and coloured by each day's worst injury, with a days-since-LTI figure animated as an @property integer through counter(), and the cross, rolling-TRIR chart, accident triangle and log all derived from one event list that the near-miss form writes into. name: Materials Need-by vs ETA
note: Need-by against supplier-ETA dumbbells whose markers are full-width layers moved by translate percentages, so an approved expedite slides the ETA on a linear() spring while float, KPIs and the weekly laydown chart (whose bars filter the timeline with a FLIP reorder) re-derive from the same dates. name: First-Time Fix with Confidence
note: A forest plot of first-time-fix rates whose 95% Wilson intervals are capsules sized with translate and scaleX, so period and trade changes spring the bounds and 'rank by lower bound' FLIP-reorders the rows, plus a van-stock what-if that re-scores every visit lost to a missing part. Set --dcf-ftf-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Site Daily Report
note: A ruled site diary whose hourly weather chart shades every gust over the tower crane's 20 m/s limit and logs those hours as a delay automatically, with sections revealed on a scroll-driven view() timeline inside the report's own scroller (with an @supports fallback) and a draft, submit, approve or return workflow. Set --dcf-daily-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Subcontractor Scorecard
note: User-weighted KPI scores where every slider input re-ranks the table with a FLIP reorder through the Web Animations API, batched to one per frame, while scores ease toward their new values in a self-stopping rAF loop and heat cells colour themselves with color-mix(in oklch) keyed to a per-cell --s. Set --dcf-subs-h to 100dvh in an app.
